title: Need 4 Speed
description: Need 4 Speed aims for optimisation on nvidia.
body:
**Need 4 Speed 🚀**

Need 4 Speed is an extreme optimisation modpack specifically built for computers with NVIDIA graphics cards. It’s total overkill for low-end PCs with GTX or RTX cards, hitting 138+ FPS* even with shaders enabled.

**    [!IMPORTANT]
    Nvidium is automatically paused when shaders are running.**

_*Performance measured on my personal setup: NVIDIA RTX 4060 & Intel Core i7._
